The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-third season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S23|Pokémon Journeys: The Series]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== Two ''Pokémon Journeys: The Series'' Collections were released by [https://shock.com.au/ Shock Entertainment] in 2021, containing the whole season between them. ===Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Collection 1=== [[File:Journeys Collection 1.jpg|thumb|Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Collection 1]] Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Collection 1 was released by [https://shock.com.au/ Shock Entertainment] in Australia on March 3, 2021 and in New Zealand on May 19, 2021. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is KAL5564B. ====Contents==== Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Galar}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Galar}}; {{roundy|10px}}" !
